articles.title: Netflix’s The Diplomat: Season 4 Review
articles.summary: Netflix's The Diplomat Season 4 has standout performances from Keri Russell and Allison Janney that elevate the series into the best political thriller on TV.
body: Spoilers below for Season 4 of Netflix’s The Diplomat. All episodes are streaming now.

Season 4 of The Diplomat, at its core, is a series of one-on-one conversations in which the fate of the world hangs in the balance. The president and vice president, first gentleman and chief of staff, prime ministers, ambassadors, and domestic workers all engage in rich, dramatic dialogue that immediately sucks you in and doesn’t loosen its grip until the season cuts to black. Tight closeups, thick tension, and carefully constructed language imbued with double, triple, and sometimes quadruple meanings unfurl in scene after scene, creating a tapestry of geopolitical and domestic conflict that’s hard to turn away from.

The Netflix series follows American Ambassador to the United Kingdom Kate Wyler (Keri Russell) as she walks the tightrope of managing a simmering international conflict while attempting to save her marriage to her husband, Hal (Rufus Sewell). In Season 4, The Diplomat continues to be a crackling, pulpy thriller with superb writing, gorgeous cinematography, and top-tier performances.
points: Netflix's The Diplomat Season 4 has standout performances from Keri Russell and Allison Janney that elevate the series into the best political thriller on TV.

articles.title: DC’s Mister Miracle Animated Series Lead Voices Confirmed
articles.summary: DC’s upcoming animated series Mister Miracle will star Josh Hutcherson (The Hunger Games, Five Nights at Freddy’s) as Scott Free and Mackenzie Davis (Speak No Evil, Terminator: Dark Fate) as Big Barda.
body: Safran also noted showrunner Tom King has written all eight episodes of the series himself. King, a prolific DC author, created the 12-issue, Eisner Award-winning 2017 Mister Miracle series alongside artist Mitch Gerads. That comic forms the basis for this upcoming animated series.

“I think that Tom King really learned a lot in his season of co-creating and executive producing Lanterns and he adapted his book Mister Miracle fully on his own, wrote all eight episodes and I think it’s just dynamite,” said Safran. “Josh Hutcherson as Scott Free and Mackenzie Davis as Big Barda. And I just think it’s a book that I’ve always loved and I remember Tom telling us early on that, every convention he goes to, at least a couple people come up to him and say this book saved my life and I love that we got to tell that story over eight episodes.”
A network or arrival date for Mister Miracle is yet to be discussed.

For its part, it’s not yet confirmed whether Lanterns is a lock for a second season, but Safran confirmed that a potential future for that series is currently being hashed out, depending on whether they can find a story worthy of following up the first season.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds' fairly generous Prologue Demo comes to Switch 2 next week
articles.summary: Capcom is letting players 'try before they buy' Monster Hunter Wilds ' on Switch 2, bringing the fairly generous 'Prologue demo' to the console before the game's full release on the platform on 4th December.
body: The demo, which arrives on 19th October, lets you play the very beginning of the game up to the beginning of Chapter 1-3,"To the Forest". It's offline-only, so you don't get to experience the full joy of four-player hunts - but you do at least get to try out all 14 weapon types, and get full access to the character creator. Also, your save data will migrate from the demo to the full game, similarly to how the demo pathing works on PC and other consoles.

Unlike other consoles, though, there is an option to play local multiplayer with the demo. This means if someone else nearby has the demo downloaded on their Switch 2, you'll be able to play with them - trying out some of the hunts in co-op (honestly, that is how the game is meant to be played, if you ask me). There has been quite a lot of speculation about how a game as massive as Monster Hunter Wilds - complete with all the controversy we saw about its performance over the year it launched - will run on Switch 2, so it's pretty neat that Capcom is giving you a chance to try it out for yourself.

articles.title: Goodbye 'Carrie,' Stephen King's Most Faithful Movie Adaptation Is Officially Back on Streaming
articles.summary: Stephen King has never been shy about how much he hated director Stanley Kubrick’s adaptation of his 1977 novel, The Shining. Although it's easily one of the best horror films of all time, Kubrick’s vision of Jack Torrance and the Overlook Hotel really rubbed King the wrong way.
body: As revealed in the book Fright Favorites: 31 Movies to Haunt Your Halloween and Beyond, King disagreed with Kubrick’s decision to cast Jack Nicholson as Jack Torrance, preferring actors like Martin Sheen, who seemed more approachable than Nicholson, whose filmography tended toward intense, unstable roles. King also criticized the changes to Wendy Torrance, played by Shelley Duvall. He called Kubrick’s adaptation of Wendy " one of the most misogynistic characters ever put on film,” a striking comment given the accusations of misogyny King has faced over the content in his novels.

However, King’s feelings about Kubrick’s adaptation have shifted — and Mike Flanagan is the reason why. The iconic horror writer and director is best known for his award-winning Netflix horror originals, such as Midnight Mass. But his adaptation of The Shining ’s ambitious sequel, Doctor Sleep, now available on Paramount Plus, ultimately changed King’s view of Kubrick’s adaptation for the better.

articles.title: Obsession Star Inde Navarrette Says She Studied Anime Like Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer to Learn Screenwriting
articles.summary: Inde Navarrette, best known for her role as Nikki Freeman in Obsession, says she took a deep dive into anime to better understand screenwriting and storytelling while waiting for her star to rise. Navarrette’s breakout role as Nikki in Obsession didn’t skyrocket her to stardom overnight.
body: During that period, she began to stream games on Twitch to make ends meet, and even started studying storytelling in film and TV by watching some of her favorite anime series — specifically, Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen.

“I transitioned into studying film and watching movies and asking, ‘Why do I like them?’” she said in an October 14 interview with The Hollywood Reporter. “What I like is anime, so like, why do I like that? I mean, Jujutsu Kaisen I find to be a very fascinating anime, but why is it so different than Demon Slayer? Why is it so different than other ones? With Jujutsu Kaisen, they play with timelines, right? With Demon Slayer, they don’t, it’s very linear. And what does that mean and how does that affect with storytelling?

“I really dove into, ‘Why is Jujutsu Kaisen so good?’ And I learned about timeline and about storytelling — how a person can have a monologue at the beginning of the episode that matters two episodes later or even at the end, and that person’s dead and you don’t learn it until then — and then attaching that to my screenwriting and trying to learn that way.”

articles.title: How to defeat Medusa in Castlevania Belmont's Curse
articles.summary: Medusa, also known as the Prophetess, is one of the first three bosses in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse that you face. You must defeat her to obtain the keys to open the gate to the catacombs.
body: Below, we explain how to beat Medusa in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse and where to find her.

You can find the Prophetess in the Holy Innocents' Cemetery region, left of Paris Streets. Early in the game, the best way to reach the cemetery is to head left from the Street of the Tomb Masons area in Paris Streets.

In the Holy Innocents' Cemetery region, keep going left until you reach the Fountain of the Lost. Drop in the water to descend into the Serpent's Lair area below. The Prophetess's boss arena is the last room on the left, past the Mirror of Life on the right side.

First, try to memorize these three attacks and how to deal with them. Once you can dodge them without any trouble, your goal is to stay on the upper platform closest to Medusa and look for the openings to attack her.

articles.title: How to kill enemies with a whip attack in Castlevania Belmont's Curse
articles.summary: You must kill enemies with a whip attack in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse if you want to upgrade the Fallen arcana. Arcanas are spells that cost mana, and you can upgrade them by spending Blessing points, which are earned from Works of Mercy tasks.
body: If you have just defeated the game's first boss and want to upgrade the Holy Cross arcana, here's how to perform a whip attack in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse.

You can use the whip you receive after defeating the Fallen, the first boss in the game, to perform whip attacks, even though it's not a weapon. Press the command to throw it and, before it connects with the enemy, you must press the attack button. A "whip attack" is a buffed attack that Rose performs with her currently equipped weapon, by propelling herself toward the enemy if you time the commands correctly. If you take longer than required to use the second command, Rose will use a normal move followed by a jump backwards.

The time frame for landing a whip attack is short, so you must press both commands as quickly as you can. Whenever you hit a whip attack, a yellow aura covers Rose's model and she performs a different attack animation.
points: You must kill enemies with a whip attack in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse if you want to upgrade the Fallen arcana.

articles.title: Epic Is Overhauling Its Anti-Cheat So That Fortnite Can Finally Come To A New Platform
articles.summary: Thanks to devices such as the Steam Deck and Steam Machine, as well as the ongoing issues with Windows, gaming on Linux looks a lot more attractive over the last few years.
body: Epic Games has announced that it is working on a Linux version for Fortnite. It's going to act as a test for Epic's overhaul of EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat), its solution to those developing multiplayer games in Unreal Engine to prevent cheating (most recently used in Gears of War: E-Day). Epic says that it has offered Linux support for its current version of EAC, but that most developers (itself included) opted not to use it and instead omit Linux support entirely because of its inability to be as protective as its Windows version.

A native rebuild of EAC, that doesn't require translation layers such as Proton, would help Epic bring the software up to par with Windows, at which point it would be comfortable finally releasing a native Linux version of Fortnite. In a blog post, Epic says that once it has reached this stage, it will make this available to other developers, too.

"We are also planning to pilot EAC Linux v2 in Fortnite first, where we’ll test it in a live environment and refine it based on what we learn. Once we’ve validated EAC v2’s effectiveness, we’ll make it available to more game developers so they can bring their multiplayer games to Linux players too."

articles.title: How to get to the top of the Prison Tower in Castlevania Belmont's Curse
articles.summary: At the top of the P rison Tower in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, you will find the Warrior, one of the initial bosses you must fight to open the gate to the catacombs.
body: Below, we explain how to get to the top of the Prison Tower in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse and where to find the carpenter's crane.

You'll find the Prison Tower on the Paris Streets map by heading north from the Gate to the Catacombs and then west. Although you can explore most of the tower, the path to the door that leads to the Roof of the Tower map is blocked. The only way to access is by using a hidden crane.

You learn about the crane from a spirit who is on the western part of the Upper Tower segment. Swing across the two yellow anchors to the west and climb onto the platform with a lever. The spirit is above it, but to reach it, you must follow the path on the left, which contains several traps. Quickly jump from one side of the wall to the other to climb, then swing to a small platform in the left corner of this room (you can break the wall on the right side to reveal a "defense up" collectible). From there, you must drop and time your whip to pull you toward a purple anchor on the left, then another one on the right.

articles.summary: Microsoft is reportedly surveying a subset of Xbox users about changing its plans for exclusive games going forward--possibly in a big way--and that's no surprise given Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has alluded to changes to the exclusivity strategy in the future.
body: At the same time, a survey like this is not necessarily indicative of anything beyond Microsoft conducting research. After all, there is an entire team at Xbox called Xbox Research that... researches all manner of things, and the results of that research doesn't always lead to changes in the marketplace.
Windows Central reports that a new survey was issued to some Xbox Insiders this week, and the site confirmed the survey to be real.
The survey asks how members might feel about the totally nuclear option of making all Xbox-developed games except Call of Duty exclusive to Xbox on console.
"Imagine it was announced that all future title releases from every Xbox-developed gaming franchise except Call of Duty will be console-exclusive to Xbox," the survey asks.

articles.title: GTA 6 Reviews: When They Could Be Released
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, but when will you be able to read reviews? According to historical precedent and a new report, reviews for the open-world crime game should be available before launch.
body: Insider Gaming reported that reviews for GTA 6 will be posted at some point before November 19, but the exact timing is unknown for now. According to insider NateTheHate, Rockstar will send copies of GTA 6 to reviewers before the end of October, so any time now, seemingly.

The last GTA game, GTA 5, was released on September 17, 2013, and reviews for the game were published starting on September 16. For Rockstar's next game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II, reviews also went live one day prior to release.
This doesn't necessarily mean Rockstar will follow the same playbook for GTA 6, however. Nothing is confirmed at this stage.

GTA 6 launches on November 19-- unless it's delayed again --for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It's expected to be the biggest game of 2026 and maybe all time, and it's reportedly on pace to earn $2 billion in revenue before launch.

articles.title: Retro Handhelds Loaded With Unlicensed Games Could Face Government Crackdown
articles.summary: The Electronic Software Association (ESA) has a serious bone to pick with retro handhelds that are packaged with tons of unlicensed pre-installed, calling these devices "superfakes" that should face some sort of suppression by the US government.
body: According to an October 6 filing with the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR)--which monitors marketplaces that are accused of engaging in or enabling piracy and counterfeiting--the ESA is urging the government to clamp down on what it calls "illicit plug-and-play consoles and handheld devices." The ESA wants the USTR to add these emulation devices to the Notorious Markets List, the agency's annual report identifying which markets are participating in such behavior, thereby barring or slowing their profits.

"In the video game sector, illicit plug-and-play consoles and handheld devices are the functional equivalent of superfakes," the ESA told the USTR. "They can look and feel like legitimate, mass-market consumer electronics: molded housings, color displays, polished user interfaces, retail packaging, product reviews, warranty-like representations, and listings on familiar e-commerce platforms. Yet their commercial appeal rests solely on a concealed memory card or internal drive loaded with hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of unauthorized copies of copyright-protected games."

articles.title: 3 months after launch, Riot announces League of Legends Classic will be killed in January: 'most have gone back to other parts of League'
articles.summary: League of Legends Classic was Riot's attempt to capitalise on nostalgia for vintage-era LoL. It stripped away most of the champions and kits introduced since 2013, reverted to an older version of the Summoner's Rift map, and promised to roll out "new" old Champions at a faster clip than in the…
body: But the nostalgia Riot must have hoped would sustain the mode hasn't proven sufficient enough to keep it running: the mode will go offline in January 2027, only six months after its launch.
"We’ve seen a lot of players have fun revisiting the olden days with Classic," a Riot spokesperson wrote in a new update. "At this point though, most have gone back to other parts of League."
As a result, the current season will be the last. "We’ll then put Classic back in the box for now, with the goal of bringing it back, likely as an event mode with adjustments and additions."

It continues: "There’s more we’re going to share in the future about what we learned from this run. That includes where we think we got Classic right, where we could have gone more classic, and where sticking too closely to the past may have held the experience back."
points: League of Legends Classic was Riot's attempt to capitalise on nostalgia for vintage-era LoL.

videos.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered - PS5/PS5 Pro/Xbox X|S Tech Review - Patch 5.01 Frame-Rate Boosts Tested
videos.summary: Digital Foundry is now fully independent! Join the DF Supporter Program and support the team:
body: Despite a rocky launch the Remastered version of The Witcher 3 is gradually improving with each patch on PS5 and Xbox - taking us up to update 5.01. Compared to the initial 5.00 version frame-rates are improved, particularly on both PlayStation consoles. Elsewhere, Tom takes a look at the broader visual upgrades in the remaster, alongside the Pro enhancements. NOTE: Hotfix 5.01b has landed since this video's creation, which CDPR promises to bring "various stability improvements to help ensure a more reliable experience while witchering across the Continent."
